title: 10 Businesses That Got Killed by the Internet
主要内容: Sears and GameStop are examples of companies negatively impacted by the rise of the internet. Sears, once the world's largest retailer, faced significant debt and declining sales due to competition from Walmart, Target, and Home Depot. Its merger with Kmart worsened its financial situation. GameStop, which specialized in video game sales, reported a $673 million loss in the previous year and faces potential bankruptcy by late 2019. Both companies struggled to adapt to online retail competition. Digital sales now account for 83% of total video game purchases, according to the Entertainment Software Association. This shift in buying habits has disrupted GameStop's "buy back and resell" business model, resulting in weak earnings and a grim prognosis for the brand.
